prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Art direction: playful fashion editorial, exquisite detail, clean sculptural composition, luminous soft daylight, rich but restrained pastel colours, tactile materials, delightful personality. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. Square editorial portrait of an elegant black-and-tan German shepherd with large upright ears and kind brown eyes against a lavender seamless backdrop, tiny yellow silk neck scarf, relaxed beautiful face, immaculate soft natural lighting. Intended final composition 1200:1200; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
